name: a11y-focus-order-visibility-check
description: Checks SC 2.4.3 Focus Order, 2.4.7 Focus Visible and 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured (Minimum) on every page state, finds the CSS and markup causes (`outline: none`, positive `tabindex`, sticky headers, CSS reordering, focus lost after DOM changes), and measures focus indicator contrast against SC 1.4.11.
